raw_response:
The issuer shows solid profitability (net margin ~12% and EBIT margin ~16%) and adequate liquidity (current ratio ~1.87). Leverage is moderate with total liabilities of 3,737M versus shareholders’ equity of 2,735M (debt-to-equity ~1.37), but there is not enough information on interest coverage to support a higher investment-grade rating with confidence.

DECISION: BBB+
